Upper Text: [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon. Then, by returning 2 cards from their trash to the bottom of the deck, they play 2 [Petrification] Tokens. (Digimon/white/3000 DP/[Your Turn] This Digimon can't suspend. [On Deletion] Trash your top security card.) After, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for each of your opponent's Digimon until their turn ends.
